Mistress '''Beldair''' is the head cook in the [[Sun Palace]] in [[Cairhien]].

==Appearance==
Mistress Beldair is a stout woman with gray hair. She is tall for a Cairhienin.

==Activities==
She is in the kitchens when [[Loial]] and [[Karldin Manfor]] arrive in the Sun Palace. She supervises [[Andil]], [[Eldrid Methin]] and [[Kasi]].
